storage.title: Keep match events for
storage.subtitle: Older games lose their timeline but keep their result, scoreboard and stats. Choosing a longer time later reads the events back from your .StormReplay files.
storage.confirm: Removes the match events of {count, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} played before {date}, freeing about {size}{lost, plural, =0 {.} one {, but # of them can't be restored later because its replay file is gone.} other {, but # of them can't be restored later because their replay files are no longer on disk.}}
storage.confirmNone: No games older than {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} still have match events, so nothing is removed now. Games lose their events once they pass that age.
storage.confirmRestore: Reads the match events of {count, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} back from their replay files, adding about {size}{lost, plural, =0 {.} one {, while # game stays without events because its replay file is gone.} other {, while # games stay without events because their replay files are no longer on disk.}}
storage.confirmNoRestore: No games in this range can get their events back, so nothing changes now.
